EX-1515 / RS-3 / PMT-F33 laminate with M55J or K13D2U: no moisture uptake value found; Rock West M55J/cyanate laminate listing gave CTE only
K13D2U prepreg datasheet (resin content, moisture) not found; no M55J prepreg resin-content datasheet found
RS-3 laminate (not neat resin) and BTCy-1 moisture uptake not found; Toray RS-3 neat resin value has no exposure condition printed
Chinese M55J/cyanate CME paper (seejournal.cn) and DTIC AD1004646 could not be downloaded; not read

CMH-17 / MIL-HDBK-17 and Hexcel 8552 datasheet: no equilibrium moisture at 50% or 85% RH printed (handbook is licensed; 8552 sheet has Tg dry/wet only); nearest generic epoxy values are NASA TP-1474 (T300/5208, 75/95% RH at 49C) and CR-3387 (AS/3501-5A, 70/90% RH)
FM 300-2M / FM 300 manufacturer TDS print no moisture uptake (only peel strength after humidity); only NASA CR-3387 gives FM-300 (not -2M) uptake; AF163-2U uptake not searched beyond the first pass
Hexcel HRH-49 datasheet prints no moisture data; Kevlar 49 regain at other RH only as a graph (Figure 2.4), no numbers extractable
EX-1515 neat resin / PMT-F33 / RS-3: no hot-wet immersion uptake found
